short.zh: 合肥恒星科技开发有限公司始建于 1993 年，是专业从事医疗检验产品（微生物检测：细菌鉴定药敏分析仪、血培养仪等）研发、生产、销售的高新技术企业，通过 ISO9001 / ISO13485 质量体系认证，产品行销全国三十多个省市自治区，全国用户 3000 多家。
short.en: Founded in 1993, Hefei Hengxing Technology Development Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise dedicated to the R&D, manufacturing and sales of medical testing products (microbiology: bacterial ID/AST analyzers, blood culture systems, etc.). Certified to ISO 9001 / ISO 13485, our products serve more than 3,000 users across over 30 provinces of China.

zh: 合肥恒星科技开发有限公司始建于 1993 年，是一家集产品研发、生产、销售、服务为一体的综合性医疗设备供应商，公司总部设在中国四大科教基地之一的合肥。公司生产的产品主要有：细菌鉴定药敏分析仪、全自动血培养仪、电解质分析仪、配套试剂和耗材。产品行销全国三十多个省市自治区，并多次在国内大型招标活动中中标。仪器适用于医院、疾控中心、动植物检疫、水产养殖、学校、科研机构等，全国用户 3000 多家，市场占有率 23% 以上。
公司生产的细菌鉴定药敏分析仪及配套试剂、全自动血培养仪及其配套培养瓶是与中国科大、安徽省立医院、安徽医大附一院等合作开发的项目；是安徽省“十五”重点科技攻关项目，荣获安徽省科技成果奖，该产品的总体性能优良，其中抗生素药敏试验专家系统填补了国内空白。全自动血培养仪有多种型号，满足各不同用量用户的需要。
经营理念：科技永恒，服务创星。合肥恒星科技开发有限公司愿以促进人类医疗卫生事业的发展为己任，携手各界同仁共同铸造民族品牌！
en: Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Hefei — one of China's four major science and education bases — Hefei Hengxing Technology Development Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive medical equipment supplier integrating R&D, manufacturing, sales and service. Our main products include bacterial identification & antimicrobial susceptibility testing (ID/AST) analyzers, fully automatic blood culture systems, electrolyte analyzers, and matching reagents and consumables. Our products are sold to more than 30 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities across China and have won numerous large-scale national tenders. Serving hospitals, CDC centers, animal & plant quarantine, aquaculture, schools and research institutes, we have over 3,000 users nationwide with a market share above 23%.

Our bacterial ID/AST analyzer and matching reagents, together with the fully automatic blood culture system and its culture bottles, were jointly developed with the University of Science and Technology of China, Anhui Provincial Hospital and the First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University. Listed as a key S&T project of Anhui's 10th Five-Year Plan and winner of the Anhui Provincial Science & Technology Achievement Award, the product delivers outstanding overall performance — its antimicrobial susceptibility expert system filled a domestic gap. The blood culture system is available in multiple models to meet different throughput needs.

Philosophy: Everlasting Technology, Star-level Service. Hefei Hengxing takes promoting the development of human healthcare as its own responsibility, working hand in hand with partners to build a national brand.
